assumptions.statement: Official design and key-area polygons are unavailable; repository provisional geometry is used only for generation, visualization, and intake review.
assumptions.impact: All geometry, metrics, figures, HTML, and PDFs require complete recalculation when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, setbacks, and land-use controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity remains unknown and no statutory value is proposed.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, age, use, condition, and ownership are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Retain-repair-adapt-replace is a method only, not a building-level decision.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, station engineering, and traffic counts are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Mobility lines are conceptual connections and require specialist review.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection boundaries and approved park implementation files are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All heritage-space interventions remain conservative and reversible concepts.

assumptions.statement: Utility, fire, drainage, energy, and communications capacity data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure proposals are service architectures, not engineering sizing.

assumptions.statement: No cleared component inventory or material-performance baseline is available.
assumptions.impact: Material passports and reuse metrics remain future pilot protocols.

assumptions.statement: No confirmed operator, budget, or event program exists.
assumptions.impact: Phasing and events are optional operating references, not commitments.

assumptions.statement: AI recognition and recommendation accuracy has not been tested on a cleared local dataset.
assumptions.impact: Every AI output requires confidence display, human review, appeal, and withdrawal.
